scope: Public API mock invariants; no pixel-rendering claim
tests: Exact canvas, font discovery/substitution, weighted CJK fallback, scaled typography, editable rich ranges, unrelated nodes preserved
Mid-import cancellation rolls back every new node without deleting unrelated content
API failure rollback includes unattached/intermediate nodes
Editable cubic path text preserves full overflow content, source geometry, reversed segment anchor, scaled typography and consumed-vector lifecycle
Point text aligns actual glyph ink to source pixels before effects and clipping without changing font size
Photoshop top-first overlay stacks reverse only at native text/range/shape/stroke assignment; source paint order remains unchanged
Missing assets, non-finite dimensions, duplicate IDs, invalid text ranges rejected before mutations
Artboards clip content and children retain source absolute-to-local coordinates
